description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle management, notification mechanisms, web request handling, WebSocket and channel communication, security, and authentication interfaces. It primarily contains class and struct declarations with virtual methods, constants, and include directives.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Interface for plugin lifecycle and notification management, including initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting WebSocket channel attachment and detachment.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with notification registration and unregistration.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses.

classes.name: IWebSocket
classes.description: Interface for WebSocket communication, handling inbound messages.

classes.name: ITextSocket
classes.description: Interface for text socket communication, handling inbound messages.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication over WebSocket.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security checks on WebSocket upgrades, requests, and JSONRPC messages, and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for creating security tokens and obtaining security officer instances.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Notification callback invoked when a plugin changes state to active.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Notification callback invoked when a plugin changes state to inactive.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Notification callback invoked when a plugin becomes unavailable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, performing cleanup.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebSocket channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a WebSocket channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for the plugin.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound WebSocket messages with JSON content.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound WebSocket messages with JSON content, identified by ID.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound text socket messages.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound raw data on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade or request is permitted.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Retrieves the security token payload.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a security token from a buffer.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Returns a security officer instance for a given token.
